# [Variadic functions in C](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/variadic-functions-in-c/problem?isFullScreen=true)
## Medium
<div class="challenge-body-html"><div class="challenge_problem_statement"><div class="msB challenge_problem_statement_body"><div class="hackdown-content"><svg style="display: none;"><defs id="MathJax_SVG_glyphs"></defs></svg><p>Variadic functions are functions which take a variable number of arguments.  In C programming, a variadic function will contribute to the flexibility of the program that you are developing.</p>

<p>The declaration of a variadic function starts with the declaration of at least one named variable, and uses an ellipsis as the last parameter, 
e.g. </p>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kt">int</span> <span class="nf">printf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">format</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">...);</span>
</pre></div>
